user.title: New time profile
user.description: A time profile calculates a value that changes over the day (for example a hot water temperature) and writes it to a device regularly.

data_description.name: For example "Circulation".
data_description.target_entity: The number, input number, thermostat or water heater that receives the value.

data_description.interval: How often the value is written (minutes).
data_description.interpolation: How the value changes between two points.
data_description.min_value: Lowest allowed value. Also the bottom of the chart.
data_description.max_value: Highest allowed value. Also the top of the chart.
data_description.step: The value is rounded to this step before writing, e.g. 0.5.
data_description.holiday_source: Optional: a Workday binary sensor or a calendar (every event is a day off).
data_description.write_threshold: Only write when the value changed by at least this amount (0 = on every change).

error.max_not_greater: The maximum must be greater than the minimum.
error.step_positive: The rounding step must be greater than 0.
error.threshold_negative: The threshold must not be negative.

abort.already_configured: This target already has a time profile.

entry_not_found.message: Time profile instance {entry_id} was not found or is not loaded.

until_in_past.message: The end time must be in the future.

date_range_reversed.message: The end date must not be before the start date.

set_override.name: Set manual profile
set_override.description: Use one profile regardless of the weekly plan, optionally until a point in time.

until.name: Until
until.description: When to return to automatic mode. Leave empty to keep the profile until it is reset.

clear_override.name: Back to automatic
clear_override.description: End a manual profile and follow the weekly plan again.

add_exception.name: Add exception
add_exception.description: Use a profile for a date range, for example a holiday.

to.name: To
to.description: Last day (inclusive). Defaults to the first day.

remove_exception.name: Remove exception
remove_exception.description: Remove an exception by its ID or all exceptions covering a date.

date.name: Date
date.description: Remove all exceptions that include this day.

apply_now.name: Apply now
apply_now.description: Calculate and write the current value immediately.
